Customer deposits stood at VND 697.4 trillion

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Comparable consolidated windows, eligible original vintage; endpoint operands require later reviewed construction.

items.meaning: Issuer-reported non-financial revenue for the stated window and scope; not bank net interest income or normalized growth.
items.name: Reported revenue

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Comparable definition and documented cycle/one-off normalization before scoring.

items.meaning: Explicitly reconciled issuer EBIT; not any operating-profit label and not automatically normalized EBIT.
items.name: Reported EBIT

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Only reported evidence; normalization and attribution need separate lineage.

items.meaning: Reported total net profit after tax in the stated consolidation scope, including minority interests when present; not common-attributable profit.
items.name: Reported net income

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Reported fact supports review; ROE requires normalized profit and average common equity, neither inferred here.

items.meaning: Reported net profit attributable to common shareholders; attribution must be evidenced, not inferred from total net income.
items.name: Reported common-attributable net income

items.meaning: Reported total assets at the balance-sheet date and stated scope.
items.name: Total assets

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Average common equity is a later governed derivation from comparable dated balances.

items.meaning: Equity attributable to common shareholders excluding minority/preferred interests as applicable, not automatically total equity.
items.name: Common equity

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Comparable multi-year cumulative CFO/normalized NPAT; bank CFO substitution prohibited.

items.meaning: Issuer net cash from operating activities over the stated window; unrelated to investor portfolio cash.
items.name: Operating cash flow

operandMappings.requirement: Compatible non-financial reporting window; capex definition and sign reconciled; no automatic scoring.

evidenceTopicMappings.requirement: Disclose total vs maintenance capex; no inference from total investing outflow.

items.meaning: Positive issuer expenditure required to sustain/grow operations, explicitly identified/reconciled from disclosed capex items; not investing cash flow.
items.name: Issuer capital expenditure

operandMappings.requirement: Positive issuer expenditure for compatible CFO window; maintenance vs total scope documented.

items.meaning: Documented normalized tax-rate input; not reported tax expense divided by profit without normalization evidence.
items.name: NORMALIZED TAX RATE

items.meaning: Identified operating assets, explicitly excluding material non-operating assets.
items.name: OPERATING ASSETS

items.meaning: Identified non-interest-bearing operating liabilities; not total liabilities.
items.name: NON INTEREST BEARING OPERATING LIABILITIES

items.meaning: Issuer-reported gross profit for exact scope/window.
items.name: GROSS PROFIT

items.meaning: Bank-reported net interest margin with documented annualization/earning-asset basis.
items.name: BANK REPORTED NIM

items.meaning: Reported receivables, composition and restrictions retained.
items.name: RECEIVABLES

items.meaning: Reported inventory; quality cannot be inferred from aggregate amount.
items.name: INVENTORY

items.meaning: Explicitly disclosed capitalized expenditure balance.
items.name: CAPITALIZED COSTS

items.meaning: Debt identified as interest bearing, short and long term with reconciliation.
items.name: INTEREST BEARING DEBT

items.meaning: Cash proven economically available; reported cash cannot implicitly be treated as unrestricted.
items.name: UNRESTRICTED CASH

items.meaning: Evidence-reconciled normalized earnings before interest tax depreciation amortization.
items.name: NORMALIZED EBITDA

items.meaning: Reported regulatory total capital adequacy ratio, regulation and scope retained.
items.name: BANK REPORTED CAR

items.meaning: Reported regulatory common-equity tier-one ratio, regulation and scope retained.
items.name: BANK REPORTED CET1

items.meaning: Regulatory nonperforming customer loans with explicit bank definition and categories.
items.name: BANK NONPERFORMING LOANS

items.meaning: Gross customer loans before loss reserves, exact matching perimeter.
items.name: BANK GROSS CUSTOMER LOANS

items.meaning: Loan-loss reserves matched to nonperforming loan definition.
items.name: BANK LOAN LOSS RESERVES

items.meaning: Current and savings account deposits under reported bank CASA definition.
items.name: BANK CURRENT AND SAVINGS DEPOSITS

items.meaning: Customer deposits, excluding interbank deposits, matching CASA definition.
items.name: BANK CUSTOMER DEPOSITS

items.meaning: Reported current assets.
items.name: CURRENT ASSETS

items.meaning: Reported current liabilities.
items.name: CURRENT LIABILITIES

items.meaning: Reported short-term interest-bearing debt.
items.name: SHORT TERM DEBT

items.meaning: Net interest expense with exact reconciliation, not generic finance cost.
items.name: NET INTEREST EXPENSE

items.meaning: Reported basic EPS; no automatic normalized/action-adjusted interpretation.
items.name: BASIC EPS

items.meaning: Documented ordinary shares outstanding and date; not weighted-average EPS shares.
items.name: ORDINARY SHARES OUTSTANDING

items.meaning: Issuer-declared dividends, not investor receipts.
items.name: CASH DIVIDENDS DECLARED

items.meaning: Issuer share repurchases, not portfolio trades.
items.name: SHARE REPURCHASES

items.meaning: Reported net interest income.
items.name: BANK NET INTEREST INCOME

items.meaning: Reported net fee/service income.
items.name: BANK NET FEE INCOME

items.meaning: Reported banking operating expenses, sign as reported.
items.name: BANK OPERATING EXPENSES

items.meaning: Reported banking operating income, perimeter as reported.
items.name: BANK OPERATING INCOME

items.meaning: Reported loan-to-deposit ratio with definition.
items.name: BANK REPORTED LDR

items.meaning: Reported credit growth with comparison window and perimeter.
items.name: BANK REPORTED CREDIT GROWTH

items.meaning: Reported total equity including any noncontrolling interests; never silently common equity.
items.name: TOTAL EQUITY

items.meaning: Reported parent-attributable profit; preference/common shareholder adjustments remain separate.
items.name: NET INCOME ATTRIBUTABLE PARENT

items.meaning: Cash payments for fixed assets and other long-term assets as captioned; not implicitly qualifying issuer CAPEX without definition reconciliation.
items.name: CASH CAPEX REPORTED
